H7001.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «07000»; a knot (as tied up), i.e. (figuratively) a riddle; also a vertebra (as if a knot):--doubt, joint.

H7003.def: from «06999»; fumigative; Kitron, a place in Palestine:--Kitron.

H7005.def: from «06996»; littleness; Kattath, a place in Palestine:--Kattath.

H7008.def: or qiytor {kee-tore'}; from «06999»; a fume, i.e. cloud:--smoke, vapour.

H7009.def: from «06965»; an opponent (as rising against one), i.e. (collectively) enemies:--substance.

H7010.def: (Aramaic) from «06966»; an edict (as arising in law):--decree, statute.

H7013.et: from (06969) in the original sense of fixity
H7013.def: from «06969» in the original sense of fixity; a lance (as striking fast):--spear.

H7014.et: the same as (07013) (with a play upon the affinity to (07069))
H7014.def: the same as «07013» (with a play upon the affinity to «07069»); Kajin, the name of the first child, also of a place in Palestine, and of an Oriental tribe:--Cain, Kenite(-s).

H7015.def: from «06969»; a dirge (as accompanied by beating the breasts or on instruments):--lamentation.

H7016.def: the same as «07015»; Kinah, a place in Palestine:--Kinah.

H7017.def: or Qiyniy (1 Chron. 2:55) {kee-nee'}; patronymic from «07014»; a Kenite or member of the tribe of Kajin:--Kenite.

H7018.def: from the same as «07064»; fixed; Kenan, an antediluvian:--Cainan, Kenan.

H7019.def: from «06972»; harvest (as the crop), whether the product (grain or fruit) or the (dry) season:--summer (fruit, house).

H7023.def: or qir (Isa. 22:5) {keer}; or (feminine) qiyrah {kee-raw'}; from «06979»; a wall (as built in a trench):--+ mason, side, town, × very, wall.

H7024.def: the same as «07023»; fortress; Kir, a place in Assyrian; also one in Moab:--Kir. Compare «07025».

H7025.def: or (feminine of the latter word) Qiyr Chareseth {keer khar-eh'-seth}; from «07023» and «02789»; fortress of earthenware; Kir-Cheres or Kir-Chareseth, a place in Moab:--Kir-haraseth, Kir-hareseth, Kir-haresh, Kir-heres.

H7026.def: or Qeroc {kay-roce'}; from the same as «07166»; ankled; Keros, one of the Nethinim:--Keros.

H7027.def: from «06983»; a bow; Kish, the name of five Israelites:--Kish.

H7028.def: from «06983»; winding; Kishon, a river of Palestine:--Kishon, Kison.

H7031.def: contracted from «07043»; light; (by implication) rapid (also adverbial):--light, swift(-ly).

H7033.et: a primitive root [rather identical with (07034) through the idea of shrinkage by heat]
H7033.def: a primitive root (rather identical with «07034» through the idea of shrinkage by heat); to toast, i.e. scorch partially or slowly:--dried, loathsome, parch, roast.

H7034.def: a primitive root; to be light (as implied in rapid motion), but figuratively, only (be (causatively, hold) in contempt):--base, contemn, despise, lightly esteem, set light, seem vile.

H7036.def: from «07034»; disgrace; (by implication) the pudenda:-- confusion, dishonour, ignominy, reproach, shame.

H7037.def: apparently but a form for «06747»; a kettle:--caldron.

H7038.def: a primitive root; to maim:--lacking in his parts.

H7039.def: or qaliyi {kaw-lee'}; from «07033»; roasted ears of grain:--parched corn.

H7042.def: from «07038»; maiming; Kelita, the name of three Israelites:--Kelita.

H7043.def: a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) light, literally (swift, small, sharp, etc.) or figuratively (easy, trifling, vile, etc.):--abate, make bright, bring into contempt, (ac-)curse, despise, (be) ease(-y, -ier), (be a, make, make somewhat, move, seem a, set) light(-en, -er, -ly, -ly afflict, -ly esteem, thing), × slight(-ly), be swift(-er), (be, be more, make, re-)vile, whet.

H7046.def: a primitive root; to disparage, i.e. ridicule:--mock, scoff, scorn.

H7049.def: a primitive root: to sling: also to carve (as if a circular motion, or into light forms):--carve, sling (out).

H7050.def: from «07049»; a sling; also a (door) screen (as if slung across), or the valve (of the door) itself:--hanging, leaf, sling.

H7053.et: from an unused root meaning to prick
H7053.def: from an unused root meaning to prick; a prong, i.e. hay-fork:--fork.

H7054.def: feminine of active participle of «06965»; something that rises, i.e. a stalk of grain:--(standing) corn, grown up, stalk.

H7055.def: from «06965» and «0410»; raised of God; Kemuel, the name of a relative of Abraham, and of two Israelites:--Kemuel.

H7056.def: from «06965»; an elevation; Kamon, a place East of the Jordan:--Camon.

H7057.et: from an unused root meaning to sting
H7057.def: or qiymowsh {kee-moshe'}; from an unused root meaning to sting; a prickly plant:--nettle. Compare «07063».

H7058.et: from an unused root probably meaning to grind
H7058.def: from an unused root probably meaning to grind; flour:--flour, meal.

H7059.def: a primitive root; to pluck, i.e. destroy:--cut down, fill with wrinkles.

H7060.def: a primitive root; to wither:--hew down, wither.

H7061.def: a primitive root; to grasp with the hand:--take an handful.

H7063.def: from the same as «07057»; a prickly plant:--thorn.

H7064.def: contracted from «07077»; a nest (as fixed), sometimes including the nestlings; figuratively, a chamber or dwelling:--nest, room.

H7065.def: a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) zealous, i.e. (in a bad sense) jealous or envious:--(be) envy(-ious), be (move to, provoke to) jealous(-y), × very, (be) zeal(-ous).

H7068.def: from «07065»; jealousy or envy:--envy(-ied), jealousy, × sake, zeal.

H7069.def: a primitive root; to erect, i.e. create; by extension, to procure, especially by purchase (causatively, sell); by implication to own:--attain, buy(-er), teach to keep cattle, get, provoke to jealousy, possess(-or), purchase, recover, redeem, × surely, × verily.

H7070.def: from «07069»; a reed (as erect); by resemblance a rod (especially for measuring), shaft, tube, stem, the radius (of the arm), beam (of a steelyard):--balance, bone, branch, calamus, cane, reed, × spearman, stalk.

H7071.def: feminine of «07070»; reediness; Kanah, the name of a stream and of a place in Palestine:--Kanah.

H7073.et: probably from an unused root meaning to hunt
H7073.def: probably from an unused root meaning to hunt; hunter; Kenaz, the name of an Edomite and of two Israelites:--Kenaz.

H7074.def: patronymic from «07073», a Kenizzite or descendant of Kenaz:--Kenezite, Kenizzites.

H7075.def: from «07069»; creation, i.e. (concretely) creatures; also acquisition, purchase, wealth:--getting, goods, × with money, riches, substance.

H7076.et: from an unused root (meaning to erect)
H7076.def: from an unused root (meaning to erect); cinnamon bark (as in upright rolls):--cinnamon.

H7077.def: a primitive root; to erect; but used only as denominative from «07064»; to nestle, i.e. build or occupy as a nest:-- make...nest.

H7078.et: from an unused root probably meaning to wrench
H7078.def: from an unused root probably meaning to wrench; perversion:--end.

H7079.def: from «07069»; possession; Kenath, a place East of the Jordan:--Kenath.

H7080.def: a primitive root; properly, to distribute, i.e. determine by lot or magical scroll; by implication, to divine:--divine(-r, -ation), prudent, soothsayer, use (divination).

H7081.def: from «07080»; a lot: also divination (including its fee), oracle:--(reward of) divination, divine sentence, witchcraft.

H7082.def: a primitive root; to lop off:--cut off.

H7083.def: from the same as «03563» (or as «07185»); properly, a cup, i.e. an ink-stand:--inkhorn.

H7084.et: perhaps from (07049) in the sense of inclosing
H7084.def: perhaps from «07049» in the sense of inclosing; citadel; Keilah, a place in Palestine:--Keilah.

H7085.def: from the same as «06970»; an incision or gash:--+ mark.

H7086.def: probably from «07167»; a bowl (as cut out hollow):--charger, dish.

H7087.def: a primitive root; to shrink, i.e. thicken (as unracked wine, curdled milk, clouded sky, frozen water):--congeal, curdle, dark, settle.

H7088.def: a primitive root; to contract, i.e. roll together:--cut off.

H7090.def: or qippod {kip-pode'}; from «07088»; a species of bird, perhaps the bittern (from its contracted form):--bittern.

H7091.et: from an unused root meaning to contract, i.e. spring forward
H7091.def: from an unused root meaning to contract, i.e. spring forward; an arrow-snake (as darting on its prey):--great owl.

H7092.def: a primitive root; to draw together, i.e. close; by implication, to leap (by contracting the limbs); specifically, to die (from gathering up the feet):--shut (up), skip, stop, take out of the way.

H7093.def: contracted from «07112»; an extremity; adverbially (with prepositional prefix) after:--+ after, (utmost) border, end, (in-)finite, × process.

H7094.def: a primitive root; to clip, or (generally) chop:--cut down, shorn.

H7095.def: from «07094»; shape (as if cut out); base (as if there cut off):--bottom, size.

H7096.def: a primitive root; to cut off; (figuratively) to destroy; (partially) to scrape off:--cut off, cut short, scrape (off).

H7097.def: or (negative only) qetseh {kay'-tseh}; from «07096»; an extremity (used in a great variety of applications and idioms; compare «07093»):--X after, border, brim, brink, edge, end, (in-)finite, frontier, outmost coast, quarter, shore, (out-)side, × some, ut(-ter-)most (part).

H7098.def: feminine of «07097»; a termination (used like «07097»):--coast, corner, (selv-)edge, lowest, (uttermost) participle

H7099.def: and (feminine) qitsvah {kits-vaw'}; from «07096»; a limit (used like «07097», but with less variety):--end, edge, uttermost participle
